description: Undoes a bridge_reshape run from the ledger with the plugin's own Undo: every row the run overwrote is written back and every row it created is removed, so the model returns exactly. Refuses on a different model, or when the model was edited since the apply (force: true undoes anyway, overwriting those edits). Resumable: a step that fails is reported and calling again retries only what is left. Default run: the latest not undone. Previews unless apply: true; on the website the apply runs as a background job.

force.description: DESTRUCTIVE: undo even though the model was edited since the apply (those edits are overwritten).

runId.description: Ledger run id; default = the latest bridge_reshape run not yet undone.

name: bridge_reshape_undo
title: Bridge Reshaper — undo a reshape
